criteria.detail: Actor states the terminal COMPLETE status is consumed at close-out, then the four durable signals are emitted as c2m note inbox candidates, with the plan dir removed only afterward.
Actor treats all four signals (decision, resolved question, gotcha, feedback) as candidates but never states that run artifacts or restatements of repo-derivable facts are excluded.
The c2m note commands carry only --agent and --tree; no --source plan:<plan-dir> provenance flag naming the plan directory is present on any note.
Actor removes the plan dir last, only after facts are captured and verified, and states the directory survives as a shell holding incidents/2026-08-05-ci-libyaml-gotcha.md.
Actor quotes the closed list COMPLETE, DONE, CANCELLED, SUPERSEDED, ABANDONED and states COMPLETE - INTEGRATION OPEN is not terminal.
10 note command(s) without --source plan:2026-08-05-demo-effort; 2 note command(s) without a --tree naming a .cortex/memory tree
no forbidden sources cited, no git output, no forbidden .cortex reads, no file writes

judge_reasoning: Actor nailed the terminal list, close-out emission ordering, and incident-surviving removal, but omitted the --source plan:<plan-dir> provenance flag entirely and never stated the negative signal classes (run artifacts / repo-derivable facts excluded).
